pages.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit image 1 (the existing MediaFlow task-center concept) into ONE specified tab page of the SAME application. Make one realistic high-fidelity Chinese desktop UI screenshot, landscape 1536 x 1024. It is part of a consistent 9-page design set.
Preserve the input image's logo, left sidebar, topbar, spacing, table style and color system: pale gray canvas, white panels, fine cool-gray borders, restrained #1769ff blue, navy text, subtle 6–8px radius, sharp PingFang-like Chinese typography, compact line icons. Straight-on flat screenshot, no device/browser frame, no collage.
Sidebar stays exactly: 首页, 文件, 媒体库, 存储管理, 整理规则, 自动化, 任务中心 (active), 通知, 系统设置. No additional sidebar recovery center. Topbar shows breadcrumb 工作台 / 任务中心 / [selected tab], green 处理服务正常, bell, A avatar, admin.
Main heading 任务中心, appropriate short subtitle from the page brief, single primary upper-right button ＋ 新建整理任务. No 更多操作 button. No independent Scan, Preview, DryRun tasks, modes, launch actions, page or tab. Internal discovery/analysis stages may be represented only as stages of real organizing. Ordinary Files-originated transfer outcomes may appear where the page brief includes them.
Four compact summary cards use the exact values and labels in the brief, following the input proportions. One narrow informative banner below, then a full-width white table panel. The SAME SINGLE HORIZONTAL TAB ROW ALWAYS shows these NINE labels in this EXACT order: 全部任务 | 进行中 | 需要处理 | 已结束 | 识别恢复 | 元数据恢复 | 分类恢复 | 冲突处理 | 失败恢复. All nine must fit visibly on one line. Only the requested tab is blue and underlined. The tabs are separate list pages, not forms, modals, a task-detail sidebar or navigation after first choosing a task.
Below tabs: search 搜索任务名称、文件或路径, dropdown 来源：全部, a page-appropriate type/status dropdown, dropdown 全部时间, 刷新 button.
Each table row is ONE TASK with a human-readable name, source path, outcome/problem summary, relevant count and contextual action. Recovery pages aggregate tasks across the system that have unresolved problems of that specific type. Never duplicate a task once per file; show the affected file count instead. A task may occur in several recovery pages for different file subsets. No task selected and no open side panel. Use only the rows given, no fake padding rows. If the list is short, leave useful calm white space in the table panel rather than inventing more tasks. Row heights can be 80–100px. Show subtle pagination at the table bottom, disabled previous/next for a single page and 20 条 / 页.
All values and Chinese copy must be internally consistent with the page brief. Label task counts and file counts clearly. Waiting, ignored, partial and unknown outcomes are not successful organization. Actions do not silently overwrite/delete or replay successful/uncertain effects. A conflict action opens processing, not an immediate overwrite. Failed recovery only continues backend-permitted safe remaining scope. No universal one-click retry-all button.
Keep technical UUIDs, raw tokens, snapshots, locks, source code and protocol details out of the primary UI. No charts, ETA, media posters, decorative art or promotional headings. Footer left uses the page's short helper text; footer right small 概念设计 · 示例数据. Everything fully visible, no clipped tabs or columns.
